title: One-Day Youth Retreat
scripture_verse: "Let no one despise your youth, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity." — 1 Timothy 4:12
date: Date: To Be Announced by Organisers
introduction: The One-Day Youth Retreat is a special spiritual gathering bringing together youth from across congregations for a day dedicated to God. Set apart from daily routines, this retreat offers heartfelt praise and adoration, empowering biblical preaching, group fellowship, and prayer for our personal walks, families, and education.
programme_overview: A full-day structured itinerary starting with morning praise, inspiring keynote sessions, fellowship activities, action songs, and a dedicated closing benediction.

highlights.title: Vibrant Praise & Worship
highlights.description: Telugu, English, and Hindi congregational worship songs exalting our God.

highlights.title: Empowering Biblical Messages
highlights.description: Practical Bible teaching on purity, discipleship, and Christian leadership.

highlights.title: Youth Fellowship & Action Songs
highlights.description: Interactive group games, joy-filled action choruses, and community building.

highlights.title: Fellowship Meals
highlights.description: Complimentary morning tea, lunch, and evening refreshments provided on campus.

guidelines: Bring your printed Bible (Telugu or English), a notebook, and a pen.
Arrive promptly before 9:00 AM to participate in the opening prayer and worship session.
Maintain decorum, modesty, and reverence inside the church sanctuary.
Come with an open, expectant heart to receive God's blessings and direction.
